text: Hello!
zh: 你好！

text: I am #:Veskar:#, a bard of the Icefall Village.
zh: 我是#:维斯卡:#，冰瀑村的吟游诗人。

text: May I help you with something?
zh: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

text: What are you doing?
zh: 你在做什么？

text: Do you miss your family?
zh: 你想念你的家人吗？

text: You have been in the capital lately?
zh: 你最近去过王都？

text: Do you know how I can get into the cepital?
zh: 你知道我要怎么才能进入王都吗？

text: See you later!
zh: 回头见！

text: The passage to the village froze, so we can't return at the moment.
zh: 通往村子的通道冻住了，所以我们暂时回不去。

text: As long as I am stuck here, I might as well be playing on my lute!
zh: 反正被困在这里，不如就弹弹我的鲁特琴！

text:
I learned a few new songs while I was in the capital!
After my return to the Icefall Village, I want to play them all for my family.
zh:
我在王都的时候学了几首新曲子！
等回到冰瀑村，我要把它们全都弹给家人听。

text: Yes, for sure.
zh: 是啊，当然去过。

text: The caravans from the Icefall Village usually have special permits to trade wares from the capital.
zh: 冰瀑村的商队通常持有特别许可，可以贩卖来自王都的货物。

text: You don't look like one of us, though.
zh: 不过，你看起来可不像我们的人。

text: Usually the guards don't ask us caravaners about a permit.
zh: 卫兵通常不会向我们这些商队成员查验许可。

text: As long as you don't #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#look like one of us#text.default#, you may have to get one, I am afraid.
zh: 只要你#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#看起来不像我们的人#text.default#，恐怕就得去弄一张了。

text: Have a wonderful day!
zh: 祝你有美好的一天！

text: Of course I do.
zh: 当然想念。

text:
My son got sick before I left the village.
I hoped to find a medicine in the capital, but they seemed to not know the illness.
zh:
我离开村子之前，我儿子病倒了。
我本指望能在王都找到药，可他们似乎根本不认识这种病。

text: Maybe, the wizards can help me, but they are out of reach for me.
zh: 也许法师们能帮我，但我根本接触不到他们。

text: There's no way I'll make it past the Marin cliffs, as I ain't a fighter.
zh: 我不会武艺，绝无可能闯过马林悬崖。
